x_casserole_dish.lore.common: Comes out of the oven so heavy that whoever carries it walks like a penguin.

x_stove_top.lore.epic: Cooked a whole family feast on four rings at once, and not a single pan boiled over.
x_stove_top.lore.legendary: Cooked so many dinners that its knobs now turn themselves to the right setting when someone says what's for tea.

x_garlic_press.lore.legendary: Squeezed every clove at a garlic festival, and the whole town smelled so strongly that the moths moved away.

x_mixing_bowl_metal.lore.common: Is so shiny inside that the baker sees a stretched, silly face every time they look in.
